classes.name: complete address
classes.label: complete address
classes.definition: delivery address that has all the address elements necessary to allow an exact match with the current Postal Service ZIP+4 and City State files to obtain the finest level of ZIP+4 and delivery point codes for the delivery address

classes.name: delivery address code set
classes.label: delivery address code set
classes.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28

classes.name: delivery point code
classes.label: delivery point code
classes.definition: specific set of digits between 00 and 99 assigned to a delivery point

classes.name: delivery point code set
classes.label: delivery point code set
classes.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28

classes.name: Department of State address
classes.label: Department of State address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, 'DPO' as the literal value for the city, and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code

classes.name: Department of State unit component
classes.label: Department of State unit component
classes.definition: component of a Department of State address that includes 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier

classes.name: general delivery address
classes.label: general delivery address
classes.definition: delivery address that uses the words 'GENERAL DELIVERY', uppercase preferred, spelled out (no abbreviation), in place of a street address

classes.name: highway contract route
classes.label: highway contract route
classes.definition: highway contract route associated with an address

classes.name: highway contract address
classes.label: highway contract address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'HC', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address

classes.name: international address
classes.label: international address
classes.definition: physical address that explicitly includes a country

classes.name: mailbox
classes.label: mailbox
classes.definition: mailbox, other than a U.S. Post Office box, associated with an address

classes.name: overseas military address
classes.label: overseas military address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses an abbreviation for the unit or command such as 'CMR', 'PSC', or 'UNIT', or 'HC', followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, either 'APO' or 'FPO' as the literal value for the city and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code

classes.name: private mail box address
classes.label: private mail box address
classes.definition: delivery address provided by a commercial mail receiving company that includes a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'PMB' or the pound "#" symbol followed by the mailbox number; alternatively, 'PMB' or '#" and the mailbox number can be appended to the street address

classes.name: Puerto Rico address
classes.label: Puerto Rico address
classes.definition: delivery address for a delivery point in Puerto Rico that may include a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'URB' followed by the name of the urbanization area that is appropriate for that address

classes.name: highway contract route address
classes.label: highway contract route address
classes.definition: mail route outside the city or township limits in a rural area associated with an address

classes.name: rural route address
classes.label: rural route address
classes.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'RR', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address

classes.name: standardized address
classes.label: standardized address
classes.definition: delivery address that is fully spelled out, abbreviated by using the Postal Service standard abbreviations or as given in the current Postal Service ZIP+4 file

classes.name: U.S. Postal Service address identifier
classes.label: U.S. Postal Service address identifier
classes.definition: combined with the ZIP + 4 code, the delivery point code provides a unique identifier for every deliverable address served by the USPS

classes.name: urbanization
classes.label: urbanization
classes.definition: an area, sector, or development within a larger geographic area

classes.name: Zip Code
classes.label: Zip Code
classes.definition: five-digit code code assigned to a delivery address indicating the state and post office or postal zone

classes.name: ZIP+4 Code
classes.label: ZIP+4 Code
classes.definition: nine-digit number consisting of five digits, a hyphen, and four digits, which the USPS describes by its trademark ZIP+4

classes.name: zip code scheme
classes.label: zip code scheme
classes.definition: system used in the U.S. to facilitate the delivery of mail, consisting of a five- or nine-digit code Zone Improvement Plan (ZIP) printed directly after the address, the first five digits (initial code) indicating the state and post office or postal zone, the last four (expanded code) the box section or number, portion of a rural route, building, or other specific delivery location

edges.name: has urbanization
edges.label: has urbanization
edges.definition: indicates area, sector, or development within a geographic area relevant to a delivery address
